purpose: Teach: 市議会/軽量/しくみ/持ち込み/冊子/薬剤師/値下げ/有識者

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 市議会との折衝、定期的にね。
lines.en: We're meeting with the city council on a regular basis.
lines.style: Clipped, efficient. The tone of someone who's moved past explanation into the practical details. Direct gaze, minimal flourish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。軽量素材、新素材、検討中です。
lines.en: Right. We're looking into lightweight materials and new options.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Engaged but not eager—the voice of someone taking careful notes. Even pace, slight nod-inflection at the end.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 仕事のしくみ、社内で共有しよう。
lines.en: Let's make sure the team knows how the work flows.
lines.style: Clear directive, not harsh. The confidence of someone delegating to someone she trusts. Measured pace, lands firmly on the request.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。資料、持ち込み制限、徹底します。
lines.en: Got it. We'll tighten up what materials people bring in.
lines.style: Brisk affirmation. No hesitation—he's already thinking through the logistics. Quick tempo, professional close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.en: And we need a fresh design for the PR booklet.
lines.style: Another item, another decision. Businesslike but not cold. The rhythm of working through a list with someone competent. Light emphasis on 'fresh.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。地域薬剤師、勉強会、開催します。
lines.en: Understood. We'll set up a study session for the local pharmacists.
lines.style: Responsive and constructive. A hint of genuine interest beneath the professionalism—he sees the value in the move. Slightly warmer than before.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 競合の値下げ攻勢、対応、急ぎだ。
lines.en: And we need to move fast on the competitor's price cuts.
lines.style: Sharpened urgency without panic. Leans forward slightly in the voice. The pressure is real but she's controlled. Lands the 'rush' element cleanly.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。有識者の意見、参考にします。
lines.en: Yes. We'll make sure to factor in what the experts say.
lines.style: Steady reassurance. He's heard the pressure and is confirming he'll bring real thought to it. Not dismissive of the experts—respectful. Calm close.
